name: Sono Hana ga Saitara, Mata Boku wa Kimi ni Deau
original_name: その花が咲いたら、また僕は君に出逢う
source:
Akito came to Mahoshi Gakuen as a transfer student and got lost as he walked around the unfamiliar vast campus. A girl with gentle eyes, Yuki, called out to him. She showed him around the school, ending at a flower garden where the flowers were still budding.

“Let’s meet here again when the flowers bloom”

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/09/25/september-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
明人作为转学生来到了真志学园，在陌生的广阔校园里走来走去时迷路了。眼神温柔的少女由希叫住了他。她带他参观了学校，最后来到了一个花园，那里的花朵还在含苞待放。

“花开之时，我们再相见吧”

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/09/25/september-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
